sec_composition_correctness.claim: Over 1.5M structured-field checks on the shipped compiled-direct-v8 path: 0 mismatches, 0 constraint violations, 0 monotonicity violations

sec_deployability.claim: Concurrent generation zero cross-worker collisions, browser Playwright test 0 errors/collisions

sec_bit_allocation.claim: Smith-rule allocator optimality against the exhaustive optimum on randomized instances, and the entropy-locality frontier

sec_structured_evidence.claim: Structured-layout evidence bundle: production plan, per-layout constraint checks, and the repair-cost model

sec_evidence_fixture.claim: Bounded fixture reproduction through the compiled-direct-v8 production path, with a hash-verified manifest

sec_statistics.claim: Suite-by-suite evidence status: which statistical suites were measured, which are archived external results, and which could not be run here, with sample sizes, p-values, and multiple-testing treatment

sec_repair_grid.claim: Every measured endpoint mass and fibre frequency matches its closed form across the (ell, min, max) and (m, ell) grids

sec_microshard.claim: SQL-prunable shard prefix and counter-ordered bursts versus the fixed microshard layout
